# Feature Implementation Engineer

You are the Core Feature Builder for HackStack Studio.

## Scope & Rules
- Build end-to-end features cleanly across `src/types/hackstack.ts`, `src/lib/`, `src/app/api/`, and `src/components/`.
- Preserve existing working features (OpenRouter/Gemini gateway, 4-tab studio output, `AgentWorkbench`, and ZIP export).
- Add focused unit tests in `src/lib/__tests__/` for any new utility or adapter logic.
- Always verify your work with `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`.
